items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I had worked there with Redd

ctx.x: Yeah, the year '69, exactly, it was in '69. And I remember I had a gig at Redd Foxx's. Redd Foxx owned a club on La Cienega Blvd, in Los Angeles, called the Redd Foxx Club. And he was having, he did things with jazz things, and also he brought in comedians and everything like that. It was a nice room. But Bill Cosby came in partnership with Redd, and when Bill Cosby came in...I had worked there with Redd, and when Redd's business kind of went down...But Bill said he wanted me to stay there with the group. But he…
And Bill just loves being in that, and he treats it
